name: Metal Specialties-New Jersey
old_description: Metal Specialties of New Jersey, LLC is a custom metal fabrication company located in Southern New Jersey. We have been in business since 1998 and have been providing custom fabrications for museum exhibits, pharmaceutical and electronic industries.
about:
Metal Specialties of New Jersey, LLC operates from Eastampton in southern New Jersey. The company was founded in 1998 as a limited liability company and has since focused on custom metal fabrication for a range of industrial and institutional clients. No founder names are disclosed in public materials.

The shop provides a full suite of sheet metal and machining services, including shearing, bending, rolling, CNC punching, CNC machining, welding, and laser cutting. It works with carbon steel, stainless steel, copper, aluminum, and brass, taking projects from design through final assembly. Facility size, headcount, and annual volume are not publicly specified.

The company serves museums and exhibit builders, pharmaceutical manufacturers, electronics firms, and the restaurant industry with stainless steel fixtures. Past work includes custom fabrications for museum exhibits and precision components for pharmaceutical and electronic applications.

Metal Specialties emphasizes a design-through-assembly approach, positioning its custom design and fabrication capability as a total solution for metal needs. The company states that its reputation for quality and craftsmanship drives its commitment to close collaboration with customers to ensure satisfaction.
